claims.statement: For the stated periodic scalar PDE with v=0, r(x)=r0+g*cos(kx), source j_s(x)=j0+s*j1*cos(kx), j0>|j1|, and g*j1>0, the spatial mean of R_+(T) strictly exceeds that of R_-(T) for every T>0.
assumptions: D>=0; common scalar diffusion across arms
time-independent sinusoidal growth/source fields and periodic domain
zero initial tolerant-state density; no source depletion, reverse switching, saturation, density dependence, competition, or field feedback
orientation changes source phase only; growth field remains fixed
claims.novelty_boundary: Maximum-principle/positive-semigroup argument is standard in form; no priority claim. Not a cancer biology theorem.
costs: requires acquisition of local net-growth field, state-entry source, motility coefficient, and source/growth phase
periodic scalar model omits boundaries, directed motion, competing states, spatially varying migration, and hidden microenvironment
claims.falsifier_or_scope_gate: Any nonzero directional drift invalidates the proof; orientation-dependent active-drug response or source depletion also invalidates the model interface.
claims.next_gate: Test against the full directed-migration model and measured spatial/lineage data; do not extrapolate to nature from the PDE alone.

claims.statement: For the same model with constant drift v, the derivative at g=0 of mean(R_+(T)-R_-(T)) is j1*F(T), where F(T)=integral_0^T exp(r0*tau)*integral_0^tau exp(-D*k^2*u)*cos(v*k*u)du d tau. At k=v=r0=1, D=0.1, T=3*pi/2, F=-18.889918547401734, so for sufficiently small positive g the aligned-source arm has lower final mean than the opposed-source arm. At g=0.01, Fourier/RK4 yields -0.188898066076 with grid sizes 32,64,128 agreeing at displayed precision.
assumptions: periodic scalar PDE with same r(x) in both arms and common constant drift
source phase is the only arm difference; R(0)=0
linear-response statement is derivative at g=0; sign conclusion for finite g follows only locally by analyticity when F is strictly negative
the numerical fixture is dimensionless and is not fitted to biological data
claims.novelty_boundary: Fourier/Dyson linear response is elementary and related PDE prior art must be searched further; novelty and priority UNKNOWN. No nature-level validation or control advantage is claimed.
costs: must measure D, directed drift v, growth mean/amplitude, source amplitude, spatial wavelength, and relevant assay horizon
active drug/target engagement must be mapped separately from fluorescence or nominal dose
finite-g crossover can shift from the derivative-at-zero crossover
claims.falsifier_or_scope_gate: A held-out randomized phase-swap assay at measured inputs fails if it gives a robust opposite sign outside parameter uncertainty; the reduced model also fails if fields or transport change with arm in unmodeled ways.
claims.next_gate: Attack nonperiodic boundaries, spatially variable durotactic/chemotactic drift, nonlinear state switching, and finite-amplitude sign regions; compare to a matched-information trajectory model.

claims.statement: A mechanical state-entry field phase-swapped against an independently measured active-drug-conditioned local growth field may causally alter lineage-linked tolerant-state accumulation through migration phase lag.
assumptions: randomized matched 3D spatial-pattern intervention with equal marginal field distributions
active-drug exposure/target engagement and local phenotype-conditioned birth/death measured independently
state-entry and migration inferred from cell tracks and lineage-linked reporters
same lineages followed through washout/rechallenge; hidden oxygen, pH, nutrients, flow, matrix remodeling, immune and density effects controlled or measured
claims.novelty_boundary: The component mechanisms are prior art. Bounded source search found no directly matched randomized phase-swap plus independently measured active exposure and same-lineage rechallenge study, but this is not priority clearance.
costs: drug diffusion/binding and active target-engagement calibration
4D cell tracking, state reporter/barcode acquisition, birth/death and transition estimation
independent chamber/organoid replicates, reporter perturbation, attrition, toxicity and data processing
claims.falsifier_or_scope_gate: Stop biological transfer if phase changes active drug, if the measured source/transport does not predict held-out conditions, or if same-lineage rechallenge does not track the proposed tolerant state.
claims.next_gate: Estimate chamber-level variance and parameter uncertainty first; preregister a paired phase-swap assay and require prediction against both marginal-only and matched-information path baselines.

claims.statement: For the dimensionless model fixture D=0.1, v=r0=1, T=3*pi/2, numerical minimization of the linear-response kernel over the declared interval 0.05<=k<=10 selects k≈1.1002978 with F≈-23.3080664; at g=0.01, spectral RK4 gives mean(R_aligned-R_opposed)≈-0.2330838231 on both N=64 and N=128 grids.
assumptions: dimensionless parameters are illustrative, not biologically estimated
source and growth amplitudes are assumed held fixed as k varies
the k search is numerical on a declared compact interval, not a certified global optimization
claims.novelty_boundary: One-dimensional numerical design optimization of a derived kernel; no novelty claim, biological calibration, or control advantage.
costs: estimate D, v, r0, T and amplitude uncertainty before selecting spatial period
fabricate and mechanically/drug-map multiple wavelengths; amplitude and transport may vary with wavelength
compare against matched-information path-based model on held-out wavelengths
claims.falsifier_or_scope_gate: The chosen wavelength is not useful if it is outside fabrication limits, the kernel is near zero under parameter uncertainty, field amplitudes vary materially with k, or held-out predictions fail.
claims.next_gate: Optimize a robust lower confidence bound over measured parameter uncertainty and feasible device periods; do not transfer the dimensionless k directly to tissue.

claims.statement: For the dimensionless fixture D=0.1, v=r0=k=j1=1 and g=0.01, the aligned-minus-opposed mean starts positive at short horizon and numerically crosses zero at T≈4.3008934; Fourier RK4 values are +0.0804656 at T=4, +0.00030655 at T=4.3, and −0.0175125 at T=4.35. The linear-response crossing is T≈4.3008730.
assumptions: conditional periodic PDE specified in proof note
dimensionless illustrative parameters; no biological calibration
finite-amplitude crossing is a numerical root search, checked on 64- and 128-point Fourier grids
claims.novelty_boundary: Time-dependent phase crossing follows from the conditional PDE; no novelty claim or biological observation.
costs: serial imaging across times before and after a measured-parameter crossing
all local field, lineage, cell motility, state transition, growth and active-drug costs listed in C9S-3
phase-crossing uncertainty must include parameter and chamber-level variation
claims.falsifier_or_scope_gate: A prespecified time course under acquired inputs does not show the predicted ordering change beyond uncertainty, or only selected post-hoc times support it.
claims.next_gate: Fit timescales from a separate pilot, freeze crossing and wavelength predictions, then test on held-out chambers and conditions.
